volumes.title: Vol. I • Shinto as Cultural OS

chapters.title: Chapter 1 : Pokémon - Why We Are Drawn to a World That Never Ends part 1
chapters.description:
[Chapter 1] Special Edition Part 1
Have you ever noticed that the worlds we return to most often are the ones where nothing is truly alien?
When was the last time you finished something and felt nothing more than that it was time to begin again?

chapters.title: Chapter 1 : Pokémon - Why We Are Drawn to a World That Never Ends Part 2
chapters.description:
[Chapter 1] Special Edition Part 2　
 
Is it possible that we love what we love precisely because it never quite belongs to us?
 
How much of what we find "natural" was never designed at all, but inherited?

chapters.title: Episode 1 -- Shinto as Japanese Cultural OS Part3
chapters.description: The quiet foundation beneath behavior, values, and everyday life

chapters.title: Episode 1 -- Shinto as Japanese Cultural OS Part2
chapters.description:
[Episode 1]  Discovering the Cultural OS  Part2
How Japanese mythology became a prototype of conduct and purity came to be understood as a process rather than a rule, and how this sensibility shaped a culture capable of both acceptance and resistance.

At the tyouzuya, visitors ritually cleanse their hands (and mind) before entering the shrine.
